{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lesser Firagh Peninsula''' was a small, sandy island located on [[Thonner/Legends|the fourth planet]] in the [[Thonner system/Legends|Thonner system]]. The island was eventually overgrown with [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] introduced accidentally from [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]]. Lesser Firagh was surrounded by a [[Salt/Legends|saline]]-infused, [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Ocean/Legends|sea]].
